modos.descricao: Policial com Firearm. Descarta equipamento nao-fetich de Gaia no fim do combate

_metadata.texto_original: Police. The Fomori Cop is armed with a firearm. If disarmed, his Rage becomes 3. At the end of the Combat Phase, the Cop discards a piece of non-fetish Equipment equipped by a Gaia creature (chosen by a random player).
_metadata.notas: Implementado via register_card_passives (slug 'fomori-cop_r5'). Auto-attack em _check_victim_attacks. Discard de equipamento no fim do combat phase. Disarm tracking por restricao 'disarmed'.
